```{r}
library(dplyr)
datas <- read.csv("C:\\COMP2501\\vgsales.csv")
head(datas)

```

```{r}
# 分析平台的热门趋势
platform_trends <-datas |> select(Platform, Year) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  count(Platform)
head(platform_trends)

platform_trends_filtered <- platform_trends |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  top_n(5, n) 
platform_trends_filtered$Platform <- reorder(platform_trends_filtered$Platform,
                                             -platform_trends_filtered$n,
                                             FUN = mean)
tail(platform_trends_filtered)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggrepel)
ggplot(platform_trends_filtered, aes(x = Year, y = n, fill = Platform)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Platform), vjust = -0.5, angle = 30,
                  max.overlaps = 20) +
  labs(title = "Popularity trends of game platforms",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Number of games released on the platform")
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
# 分析各个年份最热门的游戏平台
most_popular_platform_trend <- platform_trends |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  top_n(1, n)

ggplot(most_popular_platform_trend, aes(x = Year, y = n, fill = Platform)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Platform), vjust = -0.5, angle = 30,
                  max.overlaps = 5) +
  labs(title = "The most popular gaming platform every year",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Number of games released on the platform")
```

```{r}
# 游戏平台市占率（市占率最高的几个）

# 所有平台的游戏销售量
total_sales_allplatform <- sum(datas$Global_Sales, na.rm = TRUE) 

region_platform_data <- datas |>
  group_by(Platform) |>
  summarise(platform_sale = sum(Global_Sales, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  # 各个平台的市占率
  mutate(global_percentage = platform_sale / total_sales_allplatform * 100) 
head(region_platform_data) 

# 市占率最高的几个平台
region_platform_filtered <- region_platform_data |>
  top_n(5, global_percentage)
head(region_platform_data)

library(RColorBrewer)
myPalette <- brewer.pal(5, "Set2")
plot1 <- pie(region_platform_filtered$platform_sale, 
    labels = c("DS: 9.28%", "PS2: 13.98%", "PS3: 10.76%", "Wii: 10.31%", 
               "X360: 10.99%"), 
    radius = 1,
    border="white", col=myPalette)

```

```{r}
# 研究各个地区的游戏平台市占率
# 日本
total_sales_jp = sum(datas$JP_Sales, na.rm = TRUE)
jp_platform <- datas |>
  group_by(Platform) |>
  summarise(Japan_platform = sum(JP_Sales, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  # 计算各平台在日本地区的销售占比
  mutate(japan_percentage = Japan_platform / total_sales_jp * 100)
head(jp_platform)

jp_platform_filtered <- jp_platform |>
  top_n(5, japan_percentage) |>
  arrange(desc(japan_percentage))
head(jp_platform_filtered)

myPalette <- brewer.pal(5, "Set2")
plot2 <- pie(jp_platform_filtered$japan_percentage, 
    labels = c("DS: 13.63%", "PS: 10.88%", "PS2: 10.71%", "SNES: 9.08%", 
               "NES: 7.68%"), 
    radius = 1,
    border="white", col=myPalette)

```

```{r}
# 各地区游戏销量趋势
library(tidyverse)

# 将数据转为长数据
region_sales <- datas |>
  pivot_longer(cols = `NA_Sales`:`Other_Sales`, names_to = "region", 
               values_to = "sales")

# 将地区销量按年分类
region_sales <- region_sales |>
  select(Year, region, sales) |>
  group_by(Year, region) |>
  summarise(total_sales_region = sum(sales, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "keep")
head(region_sales)

ggplot(region_sales, aes(x = Year, y = total_sales_region, colour = region)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
  
```


```{r}
# 最受欢迎的游戏类型趋势

# 分析每年最受欢迎的五个游戏类别（由1995年开始分析，前些年游戏产业不成熟）
popular_genre <- datas |>
  select(Year, Genre, Global_Sales) |>
  group_by(Year, Genre) |>
  summarise(total_global_sales = sum(Global_Sales, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  filter(Year %in% 1995:2030) |>
  mutate(Genre = reorder(Genre, total_global_sales)) |>
  top_n(3, total_global_sales) 
head(popular_genre, 20)

ggplot(popular_genre, aes(x = Year, y = total_global_sales, colour = Genre)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Trends of popular game genre",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Total global sale of video game")
    
```


```{r}
# 排名前500的游戏中，各个发行商发行游戏之市占比
publishers_sales <- datas |>
  select(Publisher, Rank) |>
  filter(Rank %in% 1:500) |>
  group_by(Publisher) |>
  summarise(total = n()) 

publishers_sales <- publishers_sales |>
  mutate(percentage = total / sum(total) * 100) |>
  arrange(desc(percentage)) |>
  top_n(10, percentage) |>
  mutate(Publisher = reorder(Publisher, -percentage))
head(publishers_sales)

ggplot(publishers_sales, aes(x = Publisher, y = percentage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Percentage of publisher in top 500 games",
       x = "Game publisher",
       y = "Percentafe of game publisher") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
  
```

```{r}
# 假设先验概率：成功游戏的比例
prior_success <- sum(datas$Global_Sales > 1) / nrow(datas)

# 动作类成功概率（销量最高）
action_games <- datas[datas$Genre == "Action", ]
action_success_rate <- sum(action_games$Global_Sales > 1) / nrow(action_games)

# 动作类后验概率计算
posterior_success_action <- (action_success_rate * prior_success) / 
  ((action_success_rate * prior_success) + ((1 - action_success_rate) * (1 - prior_success)))
posterior_success_action

# 策略类游戏成功概率（销量最低）
strategy_games <- datas[datas$Genre == "Strategy", ]
strategy_sucess_rate <- sum(strategy_games$Global_Sales > 1) / nrow(strategy_games)

posterior_success_strategy <- (strategy_sucess_rate * prior_success) / 
  ((strategy_sucess_rate * prior_success) + ((1 - strategy_sucess_rate) * (1 - prior_success)))
posterior_success_strategy

differences <- posterior_success_action / posterior_success_strategy
differences
```
